en: This is a vintage black and white postcard featuring a historic city gate and surrounding buildings. The gate is prominently labeled 'Porta Aquileia' and there is handwritten Italian text covering much of the right and bottom parts of the card. The buildings have the architectural style typical of Italian towns, and the postcard has a date written as 28-4-1901.
